|lore=Feisty. Loyal. Heroic. Insecure. Rebel '''spy'''. Excels at trouble. Incorrigible counterpart of a mindless philosopher. Has picked up a slight flutter. A bit eccentric.
|game_text=When in battle at a site with C-3PO, may not be targeted by weapons and your destiny draws may not be canceled. Adds 3 to power, maneuver, and hyperspeed of any starfighter he is aboard. Opponent may not place cards in your Used Pile while you have fewer than 13 cards in hand.

|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “When in battle at a site with C-3PO, may not be targeted by weapons and your destiny draws may not be canceled. Adds 3 to power, maneuver, and hyperspeed of any starfighter he is aboard. Opponent may not place cards in your Used Pile while you have fewer than 13 cards in hand.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “During a battle with C-3PO, may not be targeted by weapons. While aboard a starfighter, it is power, maneuver, and hyperspeed +3. Unless you have 13 or more cards in hand, opponent may not place those cards in Used Pile.” '''What changed:''' “When in” → “During a”; removed “at a site”; “weapons and your destiny draws may not be canceled. Adds 3 to” → “weapons. While aboard a starfighter, it is”; “of any starfighter he is aboard. Opponent” → “+3. Unless you have 13 or more cards in hand, opponent”; added “those”; removed “your”; “Pile while you have fewer than 13 cards in hand.” → “Pile.”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards3.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown); page 2, slip 16. Slip image and game text from this sheet. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008193702/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf Internet Archive primary-source copy].
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo)]].
* Later text: [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo)]].
